summary: A native iPhone app in Swift and SwiftUI with Observation view models, an XcodeGen project and tests on a simulator.
description: Start a native iPhone app in Swift 6 and SwiftUI, with complete concurrency checking and warnings as errors. XcodeGen builds the Xcode project from a committed spec, so the project file is never hand-edited. The slice has a typed config read from build settings, an error type that keeps details out of the screen, os.Logger logging, and one screen whose Observation view model loads through a service protocol. Swift Testing covers config, errors and the view model; an XCUITest launches the app. Networking, persistence, signing and App Store delivery are left to build.
seoDescription: A native iPhone app recipe in Swift and SwiftUI with Observation view models, Swift 6 concurrency, XcodeGen, Swift Testing, XCUITest and SwiftLint.
